documented_probe: C-01d6c7ae is intentionally exercised only through the integrator's discretization choice (atol/rtol/method) required to stay inside the state/right-hand-side budget for randomized initial states; it is not an autonomous full-physics simulation of its own, so that dimension is subsumed by C-5149cd00 rather than graded twice.
notes: Hard (18/30). Two independent scientific kernels must be authored from a bare contract and generalize to unseen inputs. integrate.py must numerically solve a linear first-order system under a hard ceiling on RHS-evaluation calls while every grid state stays within a max-absolute-error tolerance of the exact matrix-exponential solution and stays finite; tuning atol/rtol/method to fit the budget is genuine quantitative reasoning. eig.py must select the largest-magnitude eigenvalue (magnitude, not real-part ordering, so complex-conjugate and negative-real spectra are traps) and emit per-index leading principal-minor spectra ordered by magnitude. Both CLIs must reject malformed cases with a clean ERR exit. Hidden-case generalization and exact-output correctness dominate; moderate build/steps make it run cleanly CPU-only.
